title: Diwan
desc: A cook falls in love with a wealthy man's daughter. However, after receiving her father's disparaging remarks, he embraces the challenge to amass a fortune within a year.

title: Puthiya Vaarpugal
desc: When Shanmugamani, a teacher of a village school, falls in love with Jothi, a local beauty, an evil village leader tries to break their relationship.

title: Oru Kaidhiyin Diary
desc: David, a politically active person, is married to Rosy. However, when his political idol, mistreats his wife, he vows to take revenge.

title: Chinna Thambi
desc: After an astrologer predicts that their sister will marry a man of her own choosing, three protective brothers go to dire lengths to prevent the prophecy from being fulfilled.
